verdict.rationale: Cloudflare has no built-in natural-language interface for Registrar. Natural-language operation is only reachable indirectly: an official MCP server is documented at the agent-setup page, and a Registrar API for searching, registering and managing domains is published with a machine-readable OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, so an external AI agent could drive it. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, evidence that the MCP server covers Registrar operations specifically, and hands-on reports of operating Registrar via natural language.
